usedFor: Shopify holds the products, and Nyckel labels them when “New Product” runs “Classify” on image or text data.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Classify” in Nyckel
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets a category label from your own classifier.

watchOut: “Classify” takes image or text data, so the trigger must pass one of those.
